headline: Gemini hits 1B MAUs; Cloudflare reports 519% surge in AI crawler traffic | Gemini月活破10亿，Cloudflare称AI爬虫流量激增519%

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Cloudflare: 519% surge in hyper-volumetric DDoS attacks in H1 2026, AI crawlers a key vector | Cloudflare：2026上半年超大规模DDoS攻击激增519%
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: AI爬虫正成为基础设施级威胁，影响网站可用性与抓取预算分配；需区分合法AI爬虫与恶意流量
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: Cloudflare official network data, H1 2026 report
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Cloudflare's official account cited a 519% increase in hyper-volumetric DDoS attacks detected across its network in the first half of 2026. The tweet was truncated mid-sentence, so full methodology, attack size thresholds, and the specific attribution to AI crawlers as primary vector versus contributing factor are incomplete. Cloudflare's network data typically covers ~20% of web traffic, giving it broad observational scope but not universal coverage.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: review Cloudflare bot management rules; verify robots.txt对AI爬虫的区分策略；监控异常抓取模式

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Gemini reaches 1 billion monthly active users, Google's fastest-growing product ever | Gemini月活用户达10亿，成Google增长最快产品
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: AI search流量占比持续扩大，GEO优化从可选变为必选；需重新评估agentic traffic对现有SEO策略的侵蚀程度
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Sundar Pichai official statement via Alphabet earnings/Q&A
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Pichai announced Gemini crossed 1B MAUs during official company communications, calling it Google's fastest-growing product ever and its 14th product to reach this milestone. No breakdown of daily active users, geographic distribution, or web vs. app usage was provided. The announcement came alongside broader Alphabet product metrics, not a standalone data release.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: audit current traffic for AI Overview/AI Mode引用占比；在Gemini App内测试品牌query表现

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Anthropic's unreleased Claude research version demonstrates autonomous web research capabilities | Anthropic未发布版Claude展示自主网络研究能力
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: AI agent自主检索能力加速进化，可能进一步分流传统搜索流量；知识图谱与结构化数据的重要性上升
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Anthropic official announcement, cited by expert vendor
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Anthropic tweeted about an 'unreleased research version of Claude' performing autonomous web research tasks. The tweet was truncated, so specific capabilities, benchmark results, and release timeline are unclear. The source relaying this (cyberandy) has commercial interest in AI/SEO tooling, which caps confidence. No independent verification or technical paper was cited in the available text.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: monitor Anthropic research blog for full release；评估现有内容对AI agent的可检索性
